# MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation

Version 0.1.1675465747, Google MediaPipe, Apache License 2.0. License included as LICENSE.

Files are distributed with the site so image processing can run within the browser. Only the required WebAssembly variant and model files are loaded by the library at runtime.
